description: This file declares utility functions related to formatting time according to RFC1123 standards, providing function prototypes for getting the current time and converting Unix time to RFC1123 string format.

methods.name: RFC1123_GetCurTime
methods.description: Prototype for a function that retrieves the current time formatted as an RFC1123 string into a provided buffer.

methods.name: RFC1123_FromUnixTime
methods.description: Prototype for a function that converts a Unix timestamp into an RFC1123 formatted string, stored into a provided buffer.
